title: Baked Turkey Meatball Marinara
seoTitle: Baked Turkey Meatball Marinara | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Oven-baked lean meatballs in slow-simmered tomato basil sauce
subtitle: Oven-baked lean meatballs in slow-simmered tomato basil sauce
description: Turkey meatballs with parmesan and herbs bake on sheet pans, then simmer in a big pot of marinara. Serve over whole-wheat spaghetti or polenta.
equipment: Large Dutch oven or stock pot

steps.title: Mix and shape meatballs
steps.instruction: Combine turkey, breadcrumbs, parmesan, eggs, parsley, half the garlic, Italian seasoning, and 1 tsp salt. Roll 48 golf-ball-size meatballs without overworking the mix.

steps.title: Bake meatballs until set
steps.instruction: Arrange on two parchment-lined half-sheets. Bake at 400°F for 18–22 minutes until internal temp reaches 165°F and exteriors look lightly browned.

steps.title: Start marinara base
steps.instruction: Sauté onion in olive oil over medium heat 6 minutes until soft. Add remaining garlic and tomato paste; cook 2 minutes until paste deepens to brick red.

steps.title: Simmer sauce and add meatballs
steps.instruction: Pour in crushed tomatoes with 1 cup water. Simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens enough to coat a spoon. Add baked meatballs.

steps.title: Rest and portion at the line
steps.instruction: Simmer gently 10 more minutes so meatballs absorb sauce. Meatballs should feel springy, not dense, when cut open.

proTips: A panade of breadcrumbs and milk (2 tbsp per lb) keeps turkey meatballs juicy.
Flash meatballs under broiler 2 minutes before saucing for extra browning.
Freeze half the batch sauced for an emergency pasta night.
tonightSpread: Whole-wheat spaghetti with grated parmesan at the line.
Garlic sautéed green beans with lemon.
leftovers: Meatball subs on whole-grain rolls with melted mozzarella.
Meatball soup: slice and simmer in chicken broth with orzo.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Comfort food that feels like Sunday dinner. Baking keeps grease down and makes portioning predictable for eight hungry firefighters.
mealPrepNotes: Roll meatballs uniform golf-ball size for even baking. Sauce can simmer 2 hours ahead on low and hold. Station: Bake meatballs on parchment so they release cleanly and brown on all sides with one flip. Station: Simmer sauce in the widest pot on the range for fast meatball absorption. Station: Hold sauced meatballs in a hotel pan at 165°F—do not boil or turkey dries out.
